name: Our Time
source:
The story follows Theo, a guy who is finally ready to enjoy life, his friend April, an energetic guy that keeps you on your toes, & April’s fraternal twin sister Winter, someone who loves seeing & learning new things. They all met many years ago back in a small town in the middle of the United States. Theo’s parents kicked him out when he was a teenager & he moved into his grandparents house, which is when he met April & Winter, who were on the run from their parents.

Flash forward years later they have suffered through life in their difficult little home town & have saved enough to all ditch the small hometown in the states, and decided to move to a completely new country across the ocean. They are on a journey of self discovery and a passion for life, not constrained by conservative ideologies & societal values.

However their journey begins immediately when they arrive at their new apartment. Someone is already living at the apartment! Their name is Zeke, whose mother owns the apartment. Zeke, someone who has gone through a lot in life since coming out as transgender years ago, is very understanding with the awkward situation and eventually agrees to share the flat with the three friends! They all are ready to take on life and it’s challenges together, all while learning about themselves and their relationships with those around them!

[From Itch.io]
